queue.what: San Francisco-based last-mile delivery management software for route optimization, dispatch, driver apps and tracking, used with in-house fleets or third-party delivery partners.
Delivery management platform that lets retailers and logistics providers run their own fleets or tap 250+ integrated carriers, including parcel and same-day, with branded tracking.

API-based delivery orchestration platform that aggregates local and national same-day delivery providers, such as DoorDash Drive and Uber, behind one integration. It has raised $27.8M, led by Andreess
Delivery API and dashboard that connects businesses to multiple on-demand and same-day delivery providers, with dispatch, tracking and routing.
Los Angeles-based on-demand and scheduled last-mile courier platform with a nationwide 1099 driver fleet of cars, trucks and flatbeds. It serves construction and industrial suppliers.
